meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty-five minutes, Hale. My son found out he had a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. Who decided that, and when?
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite for what, Hale, and on what evidence? If I take that now, I'm admitting something, and I'm not. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero, or why it went in before anyone called me.
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
"Generous." I'm not most parents, Hale, and a rewrite isn't generous when nobody has shown me why my son needs one. What do you actually have?
Will you take it or not?
No. Not until I've seen your evidence, and not while that zero is still sitting in his gradebook.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
To Hale, cc the Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for it being entered before anyone contacted me, and that I be shown whatever evidence you are relying on. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to see your evidence; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, which you offered, but she would not take it with no evidence on the table, and her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never showed her a document she could check.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before any evidence and then pushed her to take it as a generous deal, which made accepting look like an admission and gave her pressure instead of proof.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your side of the meeting never came near that night because you showed no evidence at all; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by asking who decided and why nobody called her, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, show her something dated tied to Owen's own work, and only then offer the 4.4 rewrite in writing.
